title: Agentfile Local Tool Config (v1)
description: Machine-local workflow preferences stored in .agentfile/config.yaml or user-global personal defaults in ~/.config/agentfile/config.yaml.

version.description: Local config schema version. Must be integer 1.

link_mode.description: How skill directories are materialized in the workspace: copy (default) or symlink (workspace-local sources only).

on_conflict.description: Collision policy for unmanaged files or user-edited managed keys/blocks. Defaults to 'ask' in interactive TTYs and 'fail' in non-TTY/CI environments.

git_exclude.description: Whether agentfile manages worktree-keyed blocks in <git-common-dir>/info/exclude for generated artifacts and .agentfile/.

load_global.description: Default machine-local runtime global-config loading policy for agentfile run (true loads native globals; false isolates when supported).
